qualifications: The eight-year / 160,000 km term is separate from the 12-volt battery warranty, which the same page limits to three years.

Covered faults include battery material/workmanship defects and deviations in battery performance. Natural ageing alone is not a promise of full capacity: the published capacity trigger is below 70% of original specification.
Repair may use individual cells or a complete reconditioned battery. The terms say capacity will be the same or better than before the problem occurred; they do not promise restoration to 100%.
Battery-care and long-term-parking instructions apply. Negligence or failure to follow the owner manual is excluded, together with applicable general warranty conditions.

The battery education page separately describes minimum four-year / 80,000 km parts cover on refurbished batteries purchased outside the original warranty. This is not an automatic extension of new-vehicle battery cover.

fact.label: Roadside assistance
fact.basis: Volvo Assistance for new vehicles sold and registered from 1 January 2024; policy limits apply
fact.scope: Volvo Australia terms for the explicitly reviewed private-buyer Volvo BEV versions; commercial-use and eligibility limits remain disclosed
qualifications: The policy opening says new vehicles sold from 1 January 2024; Purchase Information specifies sold and registered from that date. Check the original sale/registration cohort for an already-registered demonstrator.

Historical eligibility: vehicles sold and registered 1 April 2021–31 December 2023 received eight years; 1 April 2018–31 March 2021 received five years. Do not inherit eight years into current new-car facts.
Taxis are excluded from included services and may receive assistance at the driver’s expense. Do not conflate this with the separate commercial vehicle-warranty mileage limit.

Included towing applies only below 3,500 kg GVM at breakdown. At or above that threshold towing is at the driver’s expense. Standard destination is the nearest authorised Volvo retailer; a preferred retailer is permitted within 50 km of that nearest retailer, with additional costs borne by the driver.

Customer support services for qualifying mechanical disablement more than 100 km from the owner’s registered home and longer than 24 hours cover the driver and up to four passengers. This is not guaranteed support for every occupant of a seven-seat EX90.

The full policy provides up to three nights’ accommodation for the specified away-from-home event, handled case by case, and discretionary driver-mobility arrangements. The overview also describes rental-car/alternative-transport options; do not turn these into unconditional fixed entitlements.

Flat-tyre help uses a serviceable compatible spare. If a maintained supplied repair kit cannot make a temporary repair, towing to a tyre repairer or retailer is at Volvo’s expense; missing/unmaintained equipment and multiple tyre damage may be excluded.

Collision/insurance events, unattended vehicles, specified unsafe/unlawful use and other policy exclusions apply. AWD off-road assistance is limited to one claim a year on a legally trafficable road meeting the stated conditions.

The captured policy does not expressly promise traction-battery out-of-charge recovery; its out-of-fuel section describes liquid fuel. Do not manufacture an unlimited EV out-of-charge towing entitlement.
